title: SecretLeaseRequest Authorization - Production-Path Qualification
description: At-most-once authorization semantics for secret lease requests with deterministic replay protection

sections_completed.1-16: Core implementation - domain-separated canonical encoding, deterministic signatures, 13 security gates
sections_completed.17: Snapshot/restore durability - replay ledger persists through FSM snapshots
sections_completed.18: Process restart durability - lease authorization survives process crash/restart with persistent state
sections_completed.19: Real Raft leader failover - 3+ member quorum, leader crash, replay protection on new leader
sections_completed.21: Snapshot + log replay - distinct test for snapshot restore followed by log entry replay
sections_completed.22: Concurrent identical proposals - 60 concurrent requests, exactly 1 succeeds, 59 denied
sections_completed.23: Negative controls - 7 tests: expired/future credentials, clock skew, revoked node, wrong secret, no assignment, non-running
sections_completed.24: Nonce replay - covered by cross-scope tests
sections_completed.27: Signature edge cases - wrong-key, malformed, truncated, bitwise-flipped all rejected
sections_completed.32-42: Evidence bundle generation with signed manifest
